text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oooh… It's finally time. I can feel my heart pounding…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I just know my feelings will reach all those watching me!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer… I'm going to win this race.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win it so I can bring warm smiles to everyone's faces!
